text: ADD the dbviewer plugin (beta): a database viewer devtool that mounts into any DOM element and lets you inspect and edit a running RxDatabase or a static `exportJSON()` dump. It ships a data grid with a Mango query bar and document drawer, a JSON view, a live activity map, and schema, explain, replication, changes, storage and cleanup panels. System collections like the internal store, local documents and RxState collections are listed view-only. The hosted viewer page can also pair with a database on another device over WebRTC via `connectRxDBViewer()`. Added testcases for the viewer helpers and the dump data source
